title: Compare recursion before and after progress
description: You can compare two parsers for addition by watching whether the token position advances.

steps.description: tokenize separates plus signs. parse_T consumes one token and returns the next position.
parse_E_left calls itself with the same position before consuming a term. Its call counter raises an error after passing 20.
parse_E_loop consumes a term first. Each loop iteration reads another operand and combines it with the tree so far.
show puts parentheses around each binary node. The demonstration prepares tokens for 1 + 2 + 3.

steps.question: What position will the first version report when its counter stops it?
steps.answer: It reports position 0 because each recursive call received the unchanged position.

steps.description: The recording reports 21 calls at position 0 for version 1. Version 2 displays ((1 + 2) + 3) and consumes all five tokens.
The final calls display successively longer addition trees. Each new operand extends the tree with the previous result on its left.
